prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1077; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed first notice of loss. Insured reports a collision at an intersection while turning left; the other vehicle was proceeding straight through on the opposing approach. Both drivers reported as uninjured at scene, though the claimant later reported neck pain. Photos requested from insured.

Entry 2: Claimant's attorney's office contacted by phone and confirmed representation. All further communication to go through counsel. Letter of representation placed in file. Requested medical authorizations and prior treatment records through counsel.

Entry 3: Police report obtained. Officer cited the left-turning driver for failure to yield. Scene diagram shows the turning vehicle crossing into the path of oncoming traffic. Insured's statement is consistent with the diagram but notes the other vehicle may have been approaching quickly. Liability assessment ongoing.

Entry 4: Counsel submitted a treatment summary indicating whiplash diagnosis, physical therapy referral, and ongoing follow-up with a treating physician. Bills received are under review against the policy's medical payments and bodily injury coverage. Requested an independent medical review for reasonableness of treatment.

Entry 5: Reserve reviewed given liability position and injury treatment to date. Recommended a settlement evaluation once treatment is complete and records are received. Diary set for follow-up with counsel. File remains open pending medical updates.
